title: Settings
guestTitle: Sign in to see your settings
guestBody: Create a free account or sign in to manage your details.
name: Name
newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a number.
googleOnlyNotice: You sign in with Google, so there is no password to change.
signOutBody: Sign out of your account on this device.
errorInvalidInput: Please check the details and try again.
errorNotFound: We couldn't find your account. Please sign in again.
errorWrongPassword: That current password isn't right. Please try again.
errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
dataBody: Download a copy of what we keep about you, as a file.
deleteBody: Delete your account and everything on it: progress, saved lessons, and mentor requests. This cannot be undone.
deleteWarning: This removes your account for good. To go ahead, confirm below.
deleteConfirmLabel: Type DELETE or your email to confirm
adminBlocked: Admin accounts cannot be deleted here. Ask another admin to change your role first.
errorConfirmMismatch: That does not match. Type DELETE or your email.
deletedNotice: Your account is deleted. Thank you for learning with us. You are always welcome back.
